sources.title: Plectic points and Hida-Rankin p-adic L-functions

claim_check.supported_statement: The paper proves a p-adic Gross-Zagier formula computing higher Hida-Rankin p-adic derivatives in terms of plectic points; the Mordell-Weil regulator provenance is stated conjecturally.
non_guarantees: does not identify the p-adic derivative coordinate with the bare complex s-derivative
does not prove plectic regulator nondegeneracy from complex analytic rank two

sources.title: Iwasawa theory and mock plectic points

claim_check.supported_statement: Under the paper hypotheses, nonvanishing of the mock plectic invariant Q_K is an input implying p-Selmer rank two.
non_guarantees: does not derive Q_K nonvanishing from exact complex analytic rank two

claim_check.supported_statement: Theorems A-C construct plectic Heegner classes and compare them with mock plectic invariants or plectic points under stated hypotheses, while Conjectures 1.9-1.10 carry the analytic-rank and Mordell-Weil significance.
non_guarantees: does not prove complex analytic rank two implies plectic nonvanishing
